Fixture · Programme

Open Mic Comedy

Wednesday 23 September 2026, 7:00pm

Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End QLD 4101

Five minutes each for anyone who signs up. Sign-up opens at 6:30pm at the bar; the running order is drawn from a hat. New acts are welcome and regulars are asked to bring new material. Booking is not required but the room fills on wet nights.

Free. Doors open thirty minutes before the listed time. The hall is wheelchair accessible from the Example Street entrance.
